image_description: A black and white photograph showing the interior of a prison cell block. The perspective looks down a central corridor flanked by cells with vertical iron bars on both the left and right sides. The floor is concrete, and the ceiling is arched with a hanging light fixture in the foreground. At the far end of the corridor, there is a solid door or wall section illuminated by a bright light source from above, creating a high-contrast focal point. The atmosphere is stark, utilitarian, and imposing.

artifact_observations.location: Vertical bars on the right side
artifact_observations.reasoning: The vertical bars on the right exhibit very slight waviness and inconsistent thickness compared to the straighter bars on the left, which may indicate minor geometric instability in generation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the image is correctly classified as a prison/correctional facility and not a generic hallway or jail set.
To verify the linear perspective of the corridor and ensure the vanishing point and depth relationships between bars and walls are physically consistent.
To check for fusion artifacts where the bars meet the floor/ceiling and to ensure each bar is a distinct, continuous object without melting.
To assess the black and white tonal range and identify any subtle generative noise or blur artifacts.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the repeating vertical bars (consistency, straightness).
Perspective accuracy of the corridor leading to the back wall.
Texture realism of the concrete floor and plastered walls.
Lighting consistency, particularly the glow at the end of the hall.
